'''Undro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] who was the leader of the [[White Maw]] during the early year of the [[Galactic War]]. Undro and all the other [[White Maw]] bosses perished in an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] attack at their base in [[Coldstone Canyon]].<ref name="Breaking the Maw" />
